A MACEDONIA Laboratory resource with six views for looking things up and studying. In **chemistry**: the **periodic table** with electron configuration (condensed, full and as orbital boxes) and an animated atom, and the **functional groups**. In **biology and biochemistry**: the **20 amino acids** and the **nucleotides and nitrogenous bases** (DNA and RNA), with their structures and a strand complement tool. In **physics**: the **Standard Model of particles** and the **quantities and units** of the International System. Cards flip to show the key facts on the back.
